description: Project-scoped, advisory label definition catalog with system seed (refactor), user CRUD via API, and mo label list/add/remove CLI commands.

tasks.title: Server label catalog: storage, service, and system seed
tasks.spec: specs/label-catalog/spec.md#Label catalog stores project-scoped label definitions
tasks.description: Add the project-scoped label catalog storage and service on the server. Implement a LabelDefinitionRow entity + DbContext configuration + EF migration (user rows only, unique (ProjectId, Key) index, JSON supportedValues column), a SystemLabelDefinitions provider holding the virtual refactor seed (origin=system), and a LabelCatalogService that merges system+user definitions at read time and performs user CRUD with key validation, duplicate/system-key collision (409), and immutability enforcement. Wire LabelCatalogService into DI alongside EpicQuerier in MohistServiceRegistration.
acceptanceCriteria: LabelDefinitionRow is configured in MohistDbContext.OnModelCreating with HasKey(Id) and a unique index on (ProjectId, Key); a new EF migration creates the LabelDefinitions table and applies cleanly against a fresh database.
SystemLabelDefinitions exposes the refactor seed with origin=system and a description stating refactor is for changes that do not alter observable behavior.

LabelCatalogService.ListAsync(projectId) returns system definitions merged with persisted user definitions, each with key/description/origin and supportedValues when present; system definitions appear for a project that has no user rows.

Create of a user definition with a system key or an existing user key is rejected (duplicate); an invalid key (e.g. uppercase), empty description, or empty supported value is rejected and not persisted; a successful create persists origin=user.
Update/Delete targeting a system key is rejected (immutable); Delete on a missing user key is idempotent (no error); Delete on an existing user key removes it.
Catalog is project-scoped: a user definition in project A is not returned for project B.
Catalog operations do not touch Issue labels and invoke no AI/agent (verified by unit tests asserting Issue label maps are unchanged after catalog create/update/delete).
Unit tests cover merge/seed, validation, duplicate/system-key collision, immutability, idempotent delete, and project scoping; `dotnet test packages/server/tests/Mohist.Server.Tests` passes.
tasks.output: LabelDefinitionRow + DbContext config + migration; SystemLabelDefinitions provider; LabelCatalogService; DI registration in MohistServiceRegistration; passing unit tests in Mohist.Server.Tests.
tasks.notes: Per design Decisions 1-3 and 6: virtual system seeds (no Origin column; origin derived), direct DbContext service (no Orleans grain), no data migration. Keep the refactor seed's supportedValues omitted. Do not change the Issue aggregate or the existing distinct-keys label endpoint.

tasks.title: Label catalog HTTP API endpoints
tasks.spec: specs/http-api/spec.md#Label catalog API exposes project definitions
tasks.description: Expose the catalog over HTTP by extending the existing label route group in LabelsRoutes.cs. Add GET/POST /api/projects/{projectRef}/labels/catalog and PATCH/DELETE /api/projects/{projectRef}/labels/catalog/{key} (resolved via the existing ProjectResolutionEndpointFilter), delegating to LabelCatalogService and mapping validation failures to 400, duplicate/system-key/immutability to 409, create to 201, and delete to 204. Leave the existing GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/labels distinct-keys endpoint unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/labels/catalog returns all definitions (system + user) with key/description/origin and supportedValues when present; a project with no user definitions still returns the refactor system definition.

POST .../labels/catalog with { key, description, supportedValues? } returns 201 and the created entry with origin=user; duplicate key returns 409; POST with a reserved system key (e.g. refactor) returns 409 and leaves the system definition unchanged; invalid key or empty description returns 400 and does not persist.

PATCH .../labels/catalog/{key} updates an existing user definition's description and/or supportedValues; PATCH on a missing user key returns 404 and creates no entry; PATCH on a system key returns 409 and leaves it unchanged.
DELETE .../labels/catalog/{key} on a user key returns 204 and removes it; DELETE on a system key returns 409; DELETE on a missing key returns 204 (idempotent).
The pre-existing GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/labels distinct-keys endpoint is unchanged (IssueLabelsApiSpecs continue to pass).

Integration tests (e.g. LabelCatalogApiSpecs) assert read, create, update, delete, duplicate 409, invalid 400, system-immutability 409, idempotent delete, and project scoping; `dotnet test packages/server/tests/Mohist.Server.Tests` passes.
tasks.output: Extended LabelsRoutes.cs with /labels/catalog endpoints; LabelCatalog DTOs; passing API integration tests in Mohist.Server.Tests/Specs.
tasks.notes: Per design Decision 4: catalog endpoints hang off the existing route group; distinct-keys endpoint stays as-is (pure ADDED delta, no existing requirement modified).

tasks.title: mo label list/add/remove CLI commands
tasks.spec: specs/cli-interface/spec.md#mo label list surfaces the label catalog
tasks.description: Update the CLI label command group in MohistCliCommands.Label.cs so `mo label list` prints the catalog (system + user: key/description/origin, supportedValues when present) in the existing table and JSON output modes, and add `mo label add <key> --description <text> [--supported-values a,b,c]` and `mo label remove <key>` subcommands that call the new /labels/catalog endpoints. add creates origin=user; both add and remove reject attempts targeting a system key with a clear error.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo label list` against a project with the refactor seed and a user definition lists both, each row showing key, description, and origin; a project with no user definitions still lists refactor.
`mo label list --output json` emits valid JSON containing each definition's key, description, origin, and supportedValues when present.
`mo label add module --description <text> --supported-values auth,ui` creates a user-origin definition (visible in a subsequent `mo label list`).
`mo label remove <key>` removes an existing user definition; removing a missing key succeeds with no error.
`mo label remove refactor` (and `mo label add refactor`) fails with a clear error stating system definitions are immutable and leaves refactor unchanged.
CLI command specs (e.g. CliLabelCatalogSpecs) cover list (table/json), add, remove, idempotent remove, and system-key rejection; `dotnet test packages/cli/tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests` passes.
tasks.output: Updated MohistCliCommands.Label.cs (list + add + remove); passing CLI specs in Mohist.Cli.Tests.
tasks.notes: Per design Decision 5: list switches from distinct-keys to catalog (distinct-keys remains reachable via the API); add/remove hit the HTTP endpoints. Confirm flag names --description/--supported-values against existing CLI conventions during implementation; behavior is fixed by the spec.
